d:
Tejasvi yadav ne 'nitish setu' ko lekar pahli bar khulkar apni pratikriya di hai. unhonne kaha ki nitish kumar ko rajnitik rup se khatm kar diya gaya hai aur unke sath kya huaa, yah sabke samne hai. tejasvi ke is bayan ke bad bihar ki siyasat men nitish kumar aur NDA ke rishton ko lekar naee charcha chhir gaee hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
